[[File:House Bashere Sigil.png|thumb|The sigil of House Bashere depicts three red kingspenny blossoms on a field of blue.]]
'''House Bashere''' is a [[Saldaean]] noble house from the region of [[Bashere (location)|Bashere]], and has recently come to the throne of Saldaea as the royal house following the [[Last Battle]]. The sigil of House Bashere is three red kingspenny blossoms on a field of blue.{{ref/book|7|41}}

== House members ==
* Lord [[Davram Bashere|Davram t'Ghaline Bashere]], High Seat of House Bashere, Lord of [[Bashere (location)|Bashere]], [[Tyr]], and [[Sidona]], [[Guardian of the Blightborder]], [[Defender of the Heartland]], [[Marshal-General]] of Saldaea, killed during the Last Battle.
** His wife, Lady [[Deira Bashere|Deira ni Ghaline t'Bashere]], killed during the Last Battle.
*** Their son, killed fighting [[Shadowspawn]].
*** Their son, who died from a fall from a horse.
*** Their daughter, Lady [[Faile Bashere|Zarine ni Bashere t'Aybara]], Lady of the Two Rivers, now High Seat of House Bashere and Queen of Saldaea following the Last Battle.
**** Her husband, Lord [[Perrin Aybara]], Lord of the Two Rivers.
*** Their son, [[Maedin Bashere]].
